reasoning: This icon depicts a vertical ellipsis (kebab menu), which is pure user interface chrome representing 'more options' rather than any real-world task subject. In a to-do app, placing a three-dot menu icon next to a task title will be mistaken for an interactive button to edit or delete the task.
